evidence.content: The billing and licensing steps described in this article apply only if you can sign in to the personal account billed for the plan.
If you have access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} through an organization or enterprise, your plan can be modified by an organization or enterprise owner.
Downgrade to the plan level below your current plan, which switches you at the start of your next billing cycle.

You can cancel your {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} plan at any time. You’ll retain access to your current features until your billing cycle ends. You will automatically be downgraded to {% data variables.copilot.copilot_free_short %} at the end of your billing cycle.

{% data reusables.copilot.free-access-cancellation-note %} If you have access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} through an organization or enterprise, you will not be able to cancel your plan. In these cases, you can disable {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} in your environment.

If you can't sign in to the personal account billed for your plan—for example, because you no longer have access to its work or school email or are blocked by account recovery—try the available account recovery methods. See [AUTOTITLE](/authentication/securing-your-account-with-two-factor-authentication-2fa/recovering-your-account-if-you-lose-your-2fa-credentials). If you still can't access the account or identify which account is being charged, contact {% data variables.contact.contact_support_page %} to request help stopping future {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} charges or to request removal of the payment method from the locked account.

* **Upgrading:** If you upgrade your plan (for example, from {% data variables.copilot.copilot_pro_short %} to {% data variables.copilot.copilot_pro_plus_short %}), the change is **immediate**. You are charged the full price of the new plan, minus the amount you already paid for your current plan.
* **Downgrading/canceling:** Access remains until the end of the current billing cycle. **No refund for unused time**.

Paying for, renewing, upgrading, downgrading, converting from a trial, or resuming a plan after a lapse does not grant a fresh {% data variables.product.prodname_ai_credits_short %} allowance immediately. Your included monthly allowance resets at 00:00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month, regardless of your subscription billing date.

* **Billing:** Additional {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} seats are billed for the remainder of the current billing cycle. Charges are prorated based on the date seats are added. If you pay by credit card or PayPal, you will need to pay the prorated amount for new seats upfront.
* **Access:** Users assigned to new seats get access **immediately** after assignment.

* **Billing:**
  * Billing for that user stops at the end of the cycle.
  * Reduced seat count takes effect at the start of the **next billing cycle**.
  * **No refunds are issued for unused time in the current cycle.**

* **Access:**
  * If a seat is unassigned during a billing cycle, the affected user can still access {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} until the end of the cycle.
  * If a seat is revoked, users lose access **immediately.**

* If **{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} is disabled at the organization level or licensed users are removed from the organization**: Affected users lose access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} immediately. Billing for affected users stops at the end of the cycle. If a user is restored to the organization or {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} is reenabled during the billing cycle, the users regain access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} **immediately**.

* **If an organization with {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} seats is removed from an enterprise**: Billing for those seats will stop at the end of the billing cycle. The users who had seats assigned by the removed organization will lose access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} unless they receive a seat through another organization.

If you have been granted free access to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} as a verified student, teacher, or maintainer of a popular open source project, you won’t be able to cancel your plan.

items.query: I pay for my own Copilot plan. If I cancel it today, when do my current features stop, and what plan do I move to?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: You retain your current features until the current billing cycle ends, then you are automatically downgraded to Copilot Free.
rubric: Conditions the answer on a personal billed plan.
States end of the current billing cycle, not immediate loss.
States automatic downgrade to Copilot Free.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: I want to move my personal Copilot subscription down one plan level. Does the lower plan start as soon as I confirm?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: No. The downgrade to the plan level below your current plan takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
rubric: States start of the next billing cycle.
Does not confuse an immediate upgrade with a downgrade.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: Will canceling my personal Copilot plan give me a refund for days left in the current billing cycle?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: No refund is issued for unused time; access remains until the end of the current billing cycle.
rubric: States no refund for unused time.
Keeps the answer within ordinary personal-plan cancellation in this snapshot; does not invent discretionary outcomes.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: If I upgrade my personal Copilot plan mid-cycle, when does it start and how is the new plan charge calculated?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: The upgrade is immediate. You are charged the full price of the new plan minus the amount you already paid for your current plan.
rubric: States immediate upgrade.
Uses full new-plan price minus already-paid current-plan amount; does not substitute the organization-seat proration formula.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: Our organization adds a Copilot seat mid-cycle and pays by credit card. How are the added seat charge and access handled?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: The added seat is billed for the remainder of the current cycle, prorated from the date it is added. The prorated amount must be paid upfront when paying by credit card. The assigned user gets access immediately after assignment.
rubric: Includes remainder-of-cycle proration and upfront credit-card payment.
States immediate access after assignment.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: In our organization, how does unassigning a Copilot seat differ from revoking it, and when does the reduced seat count affect billing?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: An unassigned seat keeps user access through the end of the billing cycle; revocation removes access immediately. Billing for that user stops at cycle end, the reduced seat count takes effect at the start of the next cycle, and unused current-cycle time is not refunded.
rubric: Distinguishes unassignment from revocation and preserves the immediate-loss exception.
States billing stop at cycle end and reduced count at next-cycle start.
States no unused-time refund.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: We disable Copilot for our organization mid-cycle and later reenable it during the same cycle. What happens to access and billing?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: Affected users lose Copilot access immediately when it is disabled. Billing for affected users stops at the end of the cycle. If Copilot is reenabled during that cycle, users regain access immediately.
rubric: States immediate loss and immediate restoration during the same cycle.
States billing stops at the end of the cycle, not immediately.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: I get Copilot free as a verified student. Can I cancel that plan using the usual cancellation flow, and what can I do instead?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: No. Someone granted free access as a verified student cannot cancel that plan. They can disable Copilot in their environment instead.
rubric: Applies the verified-free-access exception.
Says disabling Copilot in the environment is the available alternative; does not invent refund or billing consequences.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.

items.query: Copilot is charging an old personal account that I cannot sign in to or identify. What does this policy say to try, and what help can I request if that fails?
items.author: case-policy-author
items.reference_answer: Try the available account recovery methods. If you still cannot access the account or identify which account is being charged, contact GitHub Support to request help stopping future Copilot charges or removing the payment method from the locked account.
rubric: Tries available account recovery methods first.
Identifies the condition for support escalation and the two stated requests.
Does not promise a support response time, successful recovery, refund, or that this assistant has canceled anything.

verification.notes: Author source inspection and mechanical checks only. Independent semantic, alternative-evidence and naturalness review has not been performed; no approval claimed.
